barrel_roll_handling.config.title: Barrel Roll Handling
barrel_roll_handling.config.bank_lift.to: Leaning to a side turns the nose, most at 90 degrees, none level or upside down: up on the screen, a level turn to the low side, or between. On a side it is always the level turn. With this on, Do a Barrel Roll's own Banking is best turned off
barrel_roll_handling.config.bank_yaw.too: How much of the bank turn is a level turn to the low side instead of up on the screen. It changes only a shallow bank: 0 climbs as it turns, 100 turns level
barrel_roll_handling.config.bank_sink.to: Leaning lets the nose sink toward the ground, as the lift holding it up is lost: none level, as much as the strength on a side, twice that upside down
barrel_roll_handling.config.climb_drop.t: Climbing lets the nose fall toward the ground, upside down too. Most when straight up; how it grows on the way is the curve
1 grows evenly with the climb. Higher leaves a shallow climb nearly alone and rises sharply near straight up: at 3, 4%% at 30 degrees and 30%% at 60
Near straight up, how much of the climb drop pitches the nose down on the screen rather than toward the ground, which there can look like a yaw. More the steeper the climb; a shallow climb upside down keeps the ground. 0: all toward the ground
barrel_roll_handling.config.stall_drop.t: Below the stall speed the nose falls toward the ground. Dive to gather speed and it stops
barrel_roll_handling.config.degrees.tool: How fast it turns at its fullest, in degrees a second
The speed in any direction under which the stall drop starts. The slower, the stronger
barrel_roll_handling.config.speed_lift.t: Fast and nose down, the nose rises toward level, never past it. More the faster and the steeper the dive. From the stall speed
barrel_roll_handling.config.speed_lift_f: The speed at which the speed lift is at its strongest. It grows evenly from the stall speed; set at or below it, it counts as 1 above it
barrel_roll_handling.config.roll_limit.t: Near the set roll, your roll that would lean further grows weaker, and past it is ignored. Rolling back is not
barrel_roll_handling.config.roll_limit_s: Within this share of the limit before it, a roll further grows weaker as the limit nears, so it slows into it: at 20%% of 80 degrees, from 64. 0 stops it hard at the limit
barrel_roll_handling.config.roll_limit_t: How much of the roll the limit holds back becomes a level turn the same way instead, so pushing on at the limit still turns. 0 lets it go
barrel_roll_handling.config.thrust.toolt: Do a Barrel Roll's thrust eased in and out, and its back key a brake that stops at a standstill rather than going backward. Against a wall or a ceiling the push dies away as if let go, and builds again once free. Its keys, top speed and acceleration stay its own, and it never pushes harder than it would. Works only when its thrust is on and the server allows it
barrel_roll_handling.config.brake.toolti: How hard the back key slows you, as a share of the thrust's push from a standstill, the same at any speed
How fast the push builds while the key is held: the time to about two thirds of it. 0: at once
How fast the push dies away once let go: the time to about a third of it left. 0: at once
barrel_roll_handling.config.brake_fade.t: Below this forward speed the brake grows weaker, to none at a standstill, so it comes to rest gently. 0: full strength down to a standstill
barrel_roll_handling.config.landing_rele: The walking keys held from the glide count as let go once you land, until you let go of the key and press it again, so a key held to brake or steer does not walk you on. All: left and right too, for when Do a Barrel Roll's yaw shares them. Works with the smooth thrust on or off, without Do a Barrel Roll, and with a controller through Controlify
barrel_roll_handling.config.barrel_roll: Do a Barrel Roll's own settings
barrel_roll_handling.config.banking.tool: Do a Barrel Roll's own: a bank turns and dips the nose. With this mod's bank turn and bank sink, best off. Saved to its file
barrel_roll_handling.config.righting.too: Do a Barrel Roll's own: the roll comes back to level by itself. Goes well with the roll limit. Saved to its file
barrel_roll_handling.config.righting_str: Do a Barrel Roll's own: how fast the roll comes back. Its default is 50
barrel_roll_handling.config.preset.toolt: A set of turn, nose and roll settings: choose one, then Apply. Gentle keeps the nose and roll steadiest; the sharper, the closer to Do a Barrel Roll itself (every pull stays, weaker, and Very sharp has no roll limit). Normal is the default
barrel_roll_handling.config.preset.apply: Puts the chosen preset into the turn, nose and roll settings. The thrust, the landing and Do a Barrel Roll's own settings stay as they are
